summary.en: A nucleus's mass is always slightly less than the total mass of its separate protons and neutrons, and this mass defect, converted via E = mc², equals the binding energy that would be needed to pull the nucleus completely apart — the binding energy per nucleon peaks around iron, which is why fusion releases energy for light nuclei and fission releases energy for heavy ones.
summary.et: Tuuma mass on alati veidi väiksem kui tema eraldi prootonite ja neutronite koguldess mass, ning see massidefekt, teisendatuna E = mc² kaudu, võrdub seoseenergiaga, mida oleks vaja tuuma täielikult lahku rebimiseks — seoseenergia nukleoni kohta saavutab maksimumi raua juures, mis on põhjus, miks süntees vabastab energiat kergete tuumade jaoks ja lõhustumine vabastab energiat raskete tuumade jaoks.
